title: Utilities for gsm package developers
text: Initializes new extension package standardized structure configuration: Creates package skeleton using usethis::create_package() Sets pkgdown documentation GitHub Pages Configures testthat unit testing Copies GitHub Actions workflows issue templates inst/gha_templates
code: init_gsm_package(   strPackageDir = "path/to/new/package",   lDescriptionFields = list(),   bIncludeWorkflowDir = TRUE )

title: Utilities for gsm package developers
text: Updates existing GSM package latest standardized templates: Refreshes .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ current issue templates (Bug, Feature, Technical Task, Documentation Task) Updates .github/workflows/ latest GitHub Actions workflow definitions Use function keep package’s CI/CD infrastructure synchronized latest conventions. ### check_workflow_compliance() Checks package’s GitHub Actions workflows comply gsm.utils templates: Verifies required workflow files present Checks version headers match current gsm.utils version Compares critical workflow content templates Provides detailed reporting compliance issues Can used CI/CD enforce workflow standards ## GitHub Actions Workflows inst/gha_templates/workflows directory contains standardized GitHub Actions workflow templates GSM packages: R-CMD-check.yaml: Runs comprehensive R package checks PRs main across multiple platforms (macOS, Windows, Ubuntu) R versions ensure package integrity release. R-CMD-check-dev.yaml: Lightweight R package check PRs dev branch, running Ubuntu current minimum supported R versions faster CI feedback development. pkgdown--examples.yaml: Builds deploys pkgdown documentation sites automatic example indexing via add_pkgdown_examples() example rendering via render_examples(). Creates PR preview sites /pr/{number} deploys production sites gh-pages push main dev. pkgdown-cleanup.yaml: Automatically removes pkgdown PR preview directories gh-pages branch pull requests closed keep repository clean. r_releaser.yaml: Reusable workflow building attaching R package source tarballs GitHub releases, using A2-ai/r-releaser action configurable options data compression vignette building. workflow-template-check.yaml: Ensures workflow compliance checking package’s .github/workflows directory matches gsm.utils templates. Runs pushes main release branches verifies file presence, version headers, critical content maintain standardized CI/CD across GSM packages. test-coverage.yaml: Computes test coverage using covr logs result every run. pull requests, coverage posted sticky comment updates push. coverage-summary.json (written via gsm.utils::emit_coverage_summary()) attached release asset triggered release: published event.

title: Emit Coverage Summary Artifact — emit_coverage_summary
text: output_path character path output JSON file. Default "coverage-summary.json". repo character repository name owner/repo format. Defaults GITHUB_REPOSITORY environment variable, NA unset. sha character full commit SHA. Defaults GITHUB_SHA environment variable, NA unset. ref character git ref (e.g. "refs/heads/main"). Defaults GITHUB_REF environment variable, NA unset. runner_os character runner OS label. Defaults RUNNER_OS environment variable, NA unset. r_version character R version string. Defaults .character(getRversion()). timestamp_utc character ISO-8601 UTC timestamp string. Defaults current time formatted "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ". coverage covr coverage object returned covr::package_coverage(). NULL (default), coverage computed automatically. allow_fail logical TRUE, coverage computation errors caught; JSON written coverage_percent: null error_message field instead stopping. Default FALSE. quiet logical suppress informational messages. Default TRUE.
